from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = [tuple(row) for row in grid]
    common_row, _ = Counter(rows).most_common(1)[0]
    boundary_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(rows) if tuple(row) != common_row]
    base_colors = set(common_row)
    boundary_cols = [c for c in range(len(common_row))
                     if any(grid[r][c] not in base_colors for r in boundary_rows)]
    fill = Counter(common_row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r in range(len(boundary_rows)-1):
        outrow = []
        for c in range(len(boundary_cols)-1):
            corners = [grid[boundary_rows[r]][boundary_cols[c]],
                       grid[boundary_rows[r]][boundary_cols[c+1]],
                       grid[boundary_rows[r+1]][boundary_cols[c]],
                       grid[boundary_rows[r+1]][boundary_cols[c+1]]]
            outrow.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else fill)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
